title: Berserker Gladiator - Endgame PvE
author: AionVeteran
description: A high-damage dual-wield Gladiator focused on burst windows and AoE clearing for endgame dungeons. Prioritizes crit chance and attack speed to chain Berserk uptime.
gear: Prioritize Crit Rate manastones (Rank 5+) on weapon, Attack Speed on gloves, and HP on armor. Aim for a +10 enchanted dual-wield set before tackling hard-mode dungeons.

title: Holy Support Cleric
author: HealbotPrime
description: Full support Cleric built around raid healing and group buffs. Not a solo build — shines in 6-man and 12-man content where sustained healing and cleanse matter more than DPS.
gear: Stack Magic Boost and Healing Boost manastones. Prioritize cooldown reduction on shoulders and cast speed on gloves. Keep a secondary wand for emergency DPS phases.

title: Aether Burst Sorcerer
author: FrostNova
description: Burst-oriented Sorcerer using a Fire/Ice hybrid rotation. Opener with Ice Chain to lock targets, then unload Flame Cage and Aether Hold for massive single-target damage. Great for PvP and boss fights.
gear: Magic Boost manastones on all slots. Book and orb should have +Magic Accuracy. Consider a Fire resist set for PvP matchups against other Sorcerers.

title: Shadow Assassin - PvP Ganker
author: SilentBlade
description: Stealth-focused Assassin built to pick off backline healers and casters in open-world PvP and Arenas. Relies on burst windows and quick escapes rather than sustained fights.
gear: Crit Rate and Attack Speed manastones. Dagger should be enchanted with bonus PvP damage. Keep a stealth-detection charm in inventory for counter-ganking.

title: Spiritmaster Pet Tank
author: SummonerKing
description: An unconventional Spiritmaster build that uses the Fire Spirit as a pseudo-tank while the caster applies DoTs from range. Very strong in solo PvE and small-scale PvP.
gear: Magic Boost and HP manastones. Prioritize pet-related set bonuses. A secondary Earth Spirit summon is recommended for tankier bosses.
